punchline: After a bat shattered the bones around his eyes, James Clear's way back was a steady bedtime and showing up, not a grand plan.
thirty_sec: On the last day of sophomore year, a baseball bat hit James Clear in the face: broken nose, shattered bones around his eyes, about a year away from the field. He could not jump back, so he repeated small things: bedtime, practice, study. By his last year at Denison University he was recognised as its top male athlete. Atomic Habits opens with it.
